subject: Re: Sprint to close — MAP, ramp milestones, and discount path
messages:
From: Alicia Rivera <alicia.rivera@helioanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matt Chen <matt.chen@helioanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP & commercial — aggressive close window

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The execs at Helio want to move quickly — they asked if we can get a firm commercial path tied to the MAP milestones and a discount schedule that aligns to ramp. Our procurement timeline is tight (we need a signed agreement by 11/18).

High level:
- We can commit to a 12‑month enterprise plan (starting Jan 1) if we get predictable unit economics.
- We expect to ramp to ~$600k in billed usage over the first 90 days if performance and SLAs hold.

Can you share a MAP-aligned pricing proposal that:
1) shows discount tiers by committed ARR and 90/180 day ramp triggers,
2) includes any clawbacks or sunset clauses, and
3) lists approvals needed on your side (VP/CFO/CEO).

Attached: Helio_MAP_v1.pdf (their internal MAP draft).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — Alicia

--
Alicia Rivera
Head of Product, Helio Analytics
A: 415-555-0198
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Rivera <alicia.rivera@helioanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & commercial — aggressive close window

Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the MAP. I wanted to propose a concise commercial structure we can present to your procurement team tomorrow:

Proposed (high level):
- Commit tier A: $250k annual commit → 10% list discount; tranche billing monthly.
- Commit tier B: $500k annual commit → 12% list discount + $25k onboarding credit.
- Acceleration incentive: if Helio reaches $600k billed usage within 90 days, additional 5% rebate applied retroactively to first 90 days (effectively up to 15% total on the committed portion).
- Clawback: rebate prorated if 90-day ramp not met; clawback window 12 months.

Conditions:
- MAP milestones: integration complete (API keys + KV caching config), P0 latency within SLOs, monthly usage reporting and shared success metrics.
- We need a 60% invoiced commit upfront or a committed payment schedule to qualify for the higher tier.

Attachments: proposed_pricing_sheet.xlsx (simple numbers worksheet).

Internally, I will need signoff from Sales VP and Finance for any discount above 10%. Karthik / Marissa — can you start routing this through approvals? We should prepare a one-pager justification (finance impact and clawback language) for VP/CFO review.

Alicia — if this looks directionally right I can circulate a short MAP addendum and route for approvals. When is your procurement slot for signature?

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: 650-555-1234
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Rivera <alicia.rivera@helioanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & commercial — aggressive close window

Looping in the internal ask. Quick summary for approvals thread:
- Ask: 12% standard discount at $500k commit with an additional 5% rebate if ramp to $600k within 90 days.
- Risk: revenue dilution if ramp fails; mitigations: 60% upfront invoiced commit and 12-month clawback.

Marissa — can you draft the finance impact memo (2 paragraphs + simple table) and route to Aditya and Rishi for sign-off? I recommend we:
1) present the net present value for each scenario (no ramp / partial ramp / full ramp),
2) recommend approval for a conditional 12% discount + 5% performance rebate (12% effective until rebate applied).

Alicia — tentatively we can commit to this structure if Helio signs the MAP addendum within 7 business days. Happy to jump on a 30 min call to walk the procurement team through the approval conditions.

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:01:00-08:00
Subject: RE: MAP & commercial — aggressive close window

Karthik / Hannah — reviewed the proposed structure. I can greenlight a conditional 12% discount at $500k commit provided Finance signs off on the clawback mechanism and legal approves the MAP addendum language. Two quick asks:

1) Tighten the clawback timing: make the rebate subject to completed usage verification within 30 days after the 90-day ramp window.
2) Limit the retroactive rebate cap to the committed portion (not to exceed $350k).

Marissa — please attach the draft approval memo and send to Rishi for final decision. If Finance gives the OK this week, I will approve and ask Legal to prep the DocuSign envelope.

Aditya
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Rivera <alicia.rivera@helioanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final: Approval for structured rebate (Helio)

Team,

I reviewed Marissa's memo and the projected NPV scenarios. Approve the following (final):

- Approve a 12% list discount at a $500k commit with a performance rebate of up to 5% retroactive to the first 90 days if Helio reaches $600k billed usage within 90 days.
- Rebate verification to occur within 30 days after the 90-day window; rebate capped at the committed portion (max $350k).
- Require 60% upfront invoiced payment to qualify for the higher tier. If Helio fails the ramp, clawback applied pro rata across next 12 months.

Marissa — please prepare the DocuSign envelope with the MAP addendum and the commercial schedule. Include the exec approval note (attached) and route to Legal for final language check before sending to Helio.

Alicia — we'll get you the signed addendum + DocuSign link by 11/12 if Helio is ready to sign this week.

Attachments: executive_approval_note.pdf

-Rishi
CFO, Redwood Inference
